sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

claims.text: NVIDIA VSS Blueprint 3.3 released Sep 29 (day-only, Moustafa/Sinha/Agarwal): Build Vision Agent skill (vss-build-vision-ai) + Adaptive Efficient Video Sampling (cosine patch prune + event batching); VLM+RAG+MCP video workflows on Cosmos + Nemotron.
claims.context: NVIDIA tech blog Sep 29, full body read in r4 (was locator-grade).

claims.text: Bottling-line demo: live previewable deployment <30min on 2x RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell; alert latency -17% (1021->844ms); +46% concurrent streams (13->19); 60-min summary ~half time, -80% VLM tokens (Cosmos 3 Super FP8); results vary by scene/threshold.
claims.context: Vendor-demonstrated on stated hardware/config with variance caveat.

claims.text: Reference architecture ONLY, not a generative video foundation model; Oct 1 9am PT live session is post-window, not W40 event.

limitations.text: Vendor-demo figures; do NOT generalize efficiency.
